description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing a quadrature decoder (QDEC) for NXP MCUX hardware, including configuration, data handling, attribute setting/getting, and initialization functions.

methods.name: int_to_work_mode
methods.description: Converts an integer value to the corresponding encoder work mode enum.

methods.name: qdec_mcux_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as modulation value and single phase enable.

methods.name: qdec_mcux_attr_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor attributes like modulation value and single phase status.

methods.name: qdec_mcux_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the current position value from the encoder hardware.

methods.name: qdec_mcux_ch_get
methods.description: Converts the encoder position to a rotation angle in degrees.

methods.name: init_inputs
methods.description: Initializes encoder input pins and crossbar connections.
